theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Fits the dark, modern, techy requirements for an ambitious AI/ML student portfolio. Deep dark tones provide a professional cinematic look, while high-contrast cyan accents highlight AI proficiency without relying on cliché AI-slop purple/violet.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-white

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Use asymmetrical layouts. Do not center everything. Let elements breathe with negative space.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing: py-24 or py-32 for major sections. gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optically align left. Only center hero text if balanced by a strong off-center visual.

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500 text-black font-semibold hover:bg-cyan-400 transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-sm border border-transparent shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:border-white/40 hover:bg-white/5 px-6 py-3 rounded-sm transition-colors

cards.project_card: group relative overflow-hidden bg-zinc-900/30 border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all duration-300 rounded-lg
cards.tech_card: flex items-center gap-3 p-4 bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/20 transition-all rounded-md

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0a0a0a]/80 border-b border-white/5). Links must be visible on desktop.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1). Subtle glow on hover for tech stack items.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Staggered fade-up for grids using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.hero_photo: Do NOT use a plain circle. Use a geometric mask (sharp rectangular cut, angled clip-path) combined with a retro-futuristic grid border or a glowing cyan offset stroke to fit the dark techy vibe.

iconography_and_libraries.instructions: Install and use 'react-icons/si' for Tech Stack logos (e.g., SiPython, SiCplusplus, SiJavascript, SiHtml5, SiCss3, SiMongodb, SiPostgresql, SiGithub, SiLinkedin). Use 'lucide-react' for structural UI icons.

specific_instructions_for_agent: Ensure dark mode by explicitly forcing dark backgrounds (bg-[#0a0a0a]) and white text base classes.

Tech Stack Display: Make AI Tools (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Lovable, Cursor, Antigravity) visually DISTINCT from regular tech stack. Use a 'Tracing Beam' or glowing borders for the AI section to showcase proficiency.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL buttons, navigation links, and form elements to support testing.

Contact Form: Build a working UI with standard HTML action structure. Since real email backend may not exist, standardizing it with Formspree (action='https://formspree.io/f/placeholder') or simulating the send with a Toast notification is accepted.
Resume Button: It must literally use an <a> tag with 'download' attribute or visually mimic the download action clearly.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Only use it or standard sans for body if needed. Emphasize Outfit and JetBrains Mono.
Keep styling in standard React JS components with Tailwind.
